definitions.explanation: A Japanese pasta dish of spaghetti stir-fried with ketchup, onion, green pepper, and sausage or ham. Despite the name, it was invented in Yokohama after the war and is not Italian.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ナポリタンにした。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ナポリタン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This coffee shop's Napolitan has been popular for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ナポリタン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{焦|こ}げた→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧⟦ケチャップ→ケチャップ：14719_kechappu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Napolitan made in an iron frying pan has a delicious aroma of slightly browned ketchup.

notes:
One of the best-known dishes of ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western-style Japanese cooking), strongly associated with old-fashioned ⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧ and with school and workplace cafeterias.
